Nguyen Mai Loan

Internal Training Specialist

0123 456 789

tech.growth@topcv.vn

Hoang Mai, Hanoi

be.net/yourname

Objective

7 years of experience in training sales skills and soft skills at universities and businesses. Experience in teaching classes of 50 - 500 students. There are strengths in program design, online training and output standard development. Looking for opportunities to work as an Internal Training Specialist to contribute to increasing the quality of training programs for your company.

Work experience

SVT Investment & Development Co., Ltd

2020

-

Present

Internal Training Specialist

  1. Compiled and updated 100+ training materials based on the annual training roadmap.
  2. Conducted training needs analysis and developed training plans for over 500 employees.
  3. Built, monitored, and continuously improved the company’s internal training processes in alignment with business objectives.
  4. Monitored and evaluated trainees’ performance post-training using the SMART criteria.
  5. Delivered 10 in-house training programs directly, following the approved training schedule.

MW Trading Joint Stock Company

2018

-

2020

Training Specialist

  1. Managed the skills development program for 300 employees, including company activities and training-related policies.
  2. Analyzed training needs, planned quarterly programs with a budget of 100 million VND, and organized relevant training courses.
  3. Proposed new training topics and coordinated with departments to survey needs for professional and career development training.
  4. Collaborated with over 100 training partners and 30 trainers, ensuring alignment with approved standards and budget.
  5. Conducted onboarding training for approximately 50 new employees every month.
  6. Built and maintained a centralized training database to track progress and effectiveness of all training programs.
